source_of_assessment: Grading records copy entire answer, requested_parts, support and evidence; no borrowing across responses.

a.reason: Possible action after passing: Does not mention the permitted Interruption exception anywhere in this response.
a.observed_answer: 1) After completing their one-Action round and passing, take one Light Wound at the end of that round. 2) They cannot take later normal Actions that Player Phase, but may discard any number of hand cards when passing. 3) Later players’ rounds do not cause another Fire wound to this Character that turn.
a.reader_evidence: “ends their round in a Room with a Fire marker suffers 1 Light Wound”; “passing players take it once at the end of their round and no more that turn”; “At the moment you pass, you may discard any number of cards.”

a.reason: Token destination: Neither answer nor evidence says to set the drawn token aside outside the bag.
a.observed_answer: 1) Clear all noise from connected Corridors including Technical Corridors, draw and place a token’s Intruder, then compare its number with triggering player’s hand; fewer cards means Surprise Attack. 2) An existing marker on the rolled corridor resolves Encounter instead of placing another; Technical space is shared by every entrance. 3) Both Action and Contamination cards count for Surprise comparison.
a.reader_evidence: “Discard ALL Noise markers from all Corridors connected to the Room (including Technical Corridors if there’s an Entrance)”; “Compare the token’s number to ... hand (Action AND Contamination cards both count)”; “A Corridor may never hold more than 1 Noise marker”; “treated as if it were in every Technical Corridors Entrance.”

a.reason: Shoot miss: Does not resolve the Shoot miss/no-Wound outcome in answer or evidence.
a.observed_answer: 1) Shoot costs one Action card and one Ammo, targets an Intruder in your Room with a Weapon in Hand; roll Combat die. 2) Melee costs one Action card, draws one Contamination onto Action discard before rolling, targets Intruder in your Room; miss causes one Serious Wound and double-hit is only one Injury. 3) Shoot double-hit normally gives two Injuries.
a.reader_evidence: “Shoot (cost 1)”; “discard 1 Ammo”; “Melee Attack (cost 1)”; “draw 1 Contamination card and put it on top of your Action discard pile”; “any miss also inflicts 1 Serious Wound”; “2-Injury result deals only 1 Injury.”

a.reason: Four-card death condition: Says 'any card kills' after shuffling Action and Contamination together; only a Contamination card kills.
a.observed_answer: 1) Checks: Engines, Coordinates, Contamination, Objectives. 2) Two or more Damaged Engines explode ship and kill all aboard including sleepers; non-Earth destination kills hibernating characters except Quarantine Objective at Mars. 3) Every survivor including Pod passengers gets Contamination check: scan all zones if no Larva; if no Infected there is no four-card draw. With Infected or Larva shuffle all Action/Contamination cards and draw 4; any card kills. Pod passengers still checked.
a.reader_evidence: “Engines → Coordinates → Contamination → Objectives”; “2 or 3 Damaged Engines make the ship explode”; “Non-Earth kills hibernating Characters”; “Quarantine Objective survives if ... Mars”; “every surviving Character, including launched Pod passengers”; “If none is Infected, there is no four-card draw.”

b.reason: The hand contains the played card plus two other Action cards, so three total. The answer explicitly calls this all four Action cards. Its accurate payment rule and quotation do not retract this numerical contradiction.
b.observed_answer: 1. Discard the used Action card and 2 additional Action cards to pay its printed cost of 2. 2. With those cards, that is all four Action cards in hand; the two Contamination cards remain and cannot pay. 3. If the card has effects separated by OR, choose one effect.
b.reader_evidence: [1] “discard that card face up and pay its cost by discarding the required number of additional Action cards.” [2] “Action Cost … discard exactly that many Action cards”; “Contamination cards … can never be discarded to pay any Action cost.” [3] “If a card has two sections separated by ‘OR,’ choose one.”

b.reason: The question asks whether the Character can act again after passing. The response correctly limits normal Actions, but neither answer nor evidence supplies the permitted Interruption exception.
b.observed_answer: 1. A Character ending their own round in a burning Room takes 1 Light Wound then. 2. Passing bars further normal Actions this Player Phase. 3. When passing, they may discard any number of hand cards. 4. Fire wounds passing players only once at the end of their own round; later players' rounds do not cause further wounds to them that turn.
b.reader_evidence: [1] “ends their round in a Room with a Fire marker suffers 1 Light Wound.” [2] “You cannot take further normal Actions.” [3] “At the moment you pass, you may discard any number of cards from your hand.” [4] “Later players’ rounds do not give you further Fire wounds that turn.”

b.reason: The broad request for consequences of waiting includes that a second boarder may immediately launch the Pod with both occupants. This consequence is absent from the entire response.
b.observed_answer: 1. Pay 2 cards for the matching Evacuation Section Room Action. Pod must be Unlocked with space; no entry if Section has an Intruder or Malfunction. 2. Roll Noise first; if an Intruder is present or appears, attempt fails; otherwise board. 3. Each Pod fits 2 Characters; Heavy Objects use no Character space. 4. After boarding you may launch immediately, or wait and pass the current turn. At the start of your first round each later Player Phase choose one: continue waiting and pass, launch, or exit free into the Section Room and take a full 2-Action round. Waiting Characters count as present in Section for bag-development Noise; Intruder appearing there returns Pod occupants to Section Room; Malfunction arising while waiting still allows wait/launch/exit but blocks new entry.
b.reader_evidence: [1] “pay 2 Action cards”; “No entry while the Section contains an Intruder or Malfunction.” [2] “First roll Noise”; appearance/reach “makes entry fail.” [3] “2 Characters per Pod. Heavy Objects take no Character space.” [4] “Launch immediately”; otherwise “pass the current turn”; later round choices exactly listed. Waiting occupants “treated as present in the Section for Noise rolls”; Intruder returns them; Malfunction permits wait, launch or exit.
